findings.issue: The normal-flow override is correctly scoped to `.a-header`, but the responsive rule removed the legacy ArtifactPanel close button’s `top: 8px; right: 8px`. Its absolute close button now falls back to 16px, causing the cross-scenario layout regression the doubt review sought to avoid.
findings.recommendation: Restore `top: 8px; right: 8px` on `.on-photo .artifact .a-close`; these offsets are inert for the new header’s statically positioned close button. Add a source/style assertion covering legacy absolute placement and header-scoped static placement.
